title: and but or so because
summary: Союзы, которые соединяют части предложения: **and** (и), **but** (но), **or** (или), **so** (поэтому), **because** (потому что).
ru:
## Зачем нужны союзы
С помощью союзов из двух коротких предложений получается одно, и речь звучит естественнее.
> I was tired. I went to bed. → I was tired **so** I went to bed.

## and — и
Соединяет похожие мысли.
> I opened the door **and** went in. — Я открыла дверь и вошла.
> She's smart **and** funny. — Она умная и смешная.

## but — но, а
Показывает контраст.
> I like tea, **but** I don't like coffee. — Я люблю чай, но не люблю кофе.
> It's sunny, **but** it's cold. — Солнечно, но холодно.

## or — или
Показывает выбор.
> Do you want tea **or** coffee? — Ты хочешь чай или кофе?
> We can go by bus **or** on foot.

## so — поэтому
Показывает **результат** (что получилось).
> It was raining, **so** we stayed at home. — Шёл дождь, поэтому мы остались дома.
> I was hungry, **so** I made a sandwich.

## because — потому что
Показывает **причину** (почему).
> We stayed at home **because** it was raining. — Мы остались дома, потому что шёл дождь.
> I made a sandwich **because** I was hungry.

## so или because?
**so** + результат, **because** + причина. Одну и ту же мысль можно сказать двумя способами:
> I was ill, **so** I didn't go to work. (результат)
> I didn't go to work **because** I was ill. (причина)

## Запятая
Перед **but** и **so** обычно ставим запятую. Перед **and / or / because** запятая не нужна (если предложения короткие).

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I'm tired because I'm going to bed.~~ → I'm tired, **so** I'm going to bed. (результат — **so**)
- ~~We stayed at home. Because it was cold.~~ → We stayed at home **because** it was cold. (because соединяет части)
- ~~I was ill, because I didn't go to work.~~ → I was ill, **so** I didn't go to work.
- ~~Because was cold.~~ → **Because it was** cold. (нужно подлежащее)
en:
## Why use linking words?
They join short sentences into longer ones and make speech more natural.
> I was tired. I went to bed. → I was tired **so** I went to bed.

## and
Joins similar ideas.
> I opened the door **and** went in.
> She's smart **and** funny.

## but
Shows contrast.
> I like tea, **but** I don't like coffee.
> It's sunny, **but** it's cold.

## or
Shows a choice.
> Do you want tea **or** coffee?
> We can go by bus **or** on foot.

## so
Shows a **result**.
> It was raining, **so** we stayed at home.
> I was hungry, **so** I made a sandwich.

## because
Shows a **reason**.
> We stayed at home **because** it was raining.
> I made a sandwich **because** I was hungry.

## so or because?
**so** + result, **because** + reason.
> I was ill, **so** I didn't go to work.
> I didn't go to work **because** I was ill.

## Commas
Use a comma before **but** and **so**. You don't need one before **and / or / because** in short sentences.

## Common mistakes
- ~~Because it was cold. We stayed home.~~ → We stayed home **because** it was cold.
- ~~I'm tired because I'm going to bed.~~ → I'm tired, **so** I'm going to bed.
structure:
## Схема
| Союз | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| and | и | I read and relax. |
| but | но | He's rich, but he's not happy. |
| or | или | Tea or coffee? |
| so | поэтому (результат) | I was cold, so I put on a coat. |
| because | потому что (причина) | I put on a coat because I was cold. |

## Формулы
> Предложение 1 + **, but / , so** + предложение 2
> Предложение 1 + **and / or / because** + предложение 2
> **Because** + причина может стоять и в начале: *Because it was cold, I put on a coat.* (запятая после причины)

## Запомните
- После **because** и **so** — полное предложение с подлежащим и глаголом.
- **because of** + существительное: *We stayed home because of the rain.*

items.text: I'd like to go out, {{but}} I'm too tired.
Do you want to go by bus {{or}} by taxi?
He's very rich, {{but}} he isn't happy.
We can have pasta {{or}} rice for dinner.
My mother is a nurse {{and}} my father is a driver.
I like swimming, {{but}} I don't like running.
I was thirsty, {{so}} I drank some water.
She was late {{because}} the bus didn't come.
It was very cold, {{so}} we put on our coats.
We didn't go out {{because}} it was raining.
He doesn't have a car, {{so}} he walks to work.
I'm happy {{because}} it's my birthday today.
The shop was closed, {{so}} I went home.

items.q: I like him, ___ he is very kind.
The film was boring, ___ we left early.
I phoned her, ___ she didn't answer.
Shall we eat at home ___ in a restaurant?
He studied hard, ___ he passed the exam.
She didn't eat ___ she wasn't hungry.
We went to the shop ___ bought some milk.
Как сказать «Я не пошла на работу, потому что заболела»?
options: I didn't go to work because I was ill.
I didn't go to work so I was ill.
I didn't go to work but I was ill.

items.q: Как сказать «Было жарко, поэтому мы пошли купаться»?
options: It was hot because we went swimming.
It was hot, so we went swimming.
It was hot or we went swimming.

items.q: Как сказать «Я хочу пойти, но у меня нет времени»?
options: I want to go, so I haven't got time.
I want to go, because I haven't got time.
I want to go, but I haven't got time.
We stayed at home. Because it was cold.
We stayed at home because it was cold.
We stayed at home because was cold.
items.why: **because** соединяет части, после него полное предложение.

exercises.title: Соедините предложения
exercises.instruction: Соедините два предложения с помощью союза в скобках.

items.prompt: I was tired. I went to bed. (so)
answers: I was tired, so I went to bed.
I was tired so I went to bed.

items.prompt: He didn't go out. It was raining. (because)

items.prompt: We were hungry. We ate pizza. (so)

items.prompt: I can't come tomorrow. I'm busy. (because)
